items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: I went in and I looked and who was sitting on a high chair was Charlie Parker and playing a plastic saxophone with his leg in a cast. I nearly fell over.

ctx.x: So all the students that graduate every year from the universities if they come and ask for your advice about making a living, do you have anything you can tell them these days?

Well I would say to you know other areas in the music business actually they’d be able to focus on too also as well. I mean such as arranging and of course I mean there’s an A&R man or you know as I say always have something that you can really have on the side actually because you know it’d be pretty hard to live as a jazz player unless you are able to really get yourself a good group and a good agent and a good recording, a good CD and a lot of distribution and that takes time but it works. That’s the way that…
